expected_structural_delta: No new modules, owners, representations or layers. One predicate helper in warm.go, a narrow deferral branch in Controller.Start, and one focused test file.
minimum_design: Extend the existing warm planner (pkg/farmcapacity/warm.go WarmStarts) to also return the broker's current queue-head inert owner and fenced granted owners whose container never started, and have Controller.Start defer (ErrQueued) a failed Docker start of an owner that already held its grant. No new owner, store, or protocol.
outcome: A native queued farm never strands the broker queue head or a charged never-started builder after a Docker restart, and one persistently failing builder start cannot stall queue-driven planning for the whole farm.

reuse_decisions.name: Warm planner WarmStarts/warmPoolStarts
reuse_decisions.rationale: It is already the only routine retry path for queued native owners; adding the head and granted cases there keeps one planner.

reuse_decisions.name: Broker Diagnose QueueHead and Status grants
reuse_decisions.rationale: Existing read-only broker views identify the head and the exact grant fence without new state.

reuse_decisions.name: ErrQueued / exit 75 deferral
reuse_decisions.rationale: Existing shell contract already treats 75 as a non-failing deferral and preserves receipts and grants.
